_comment: Labels and SEO copy for the blog topic taxonomy. Posts already declared
`topics:` in their front matter; this is what turns those slugs into hub
pages with real titles and distinct descriptions.
A hub is only generated for a topic with at least MIN_TOPIC_POSTS posts
(see eleventy.config.js). Slugs below that threshold still get a label so
the chips on a post read properly, they just do not become a page — a hub
listing one post is index bloat, not a hub.
Descriptions must stay distinct from each other. Near-identical taxonomy
descriptions are the classic way a tag archive turns into duplicate content.

queue.label: Message queues
queue.title: Message queue articles
queue.description: Articles on running Node.js services over a message queue: work queues, competing consumers, guaranteed delivery, back-pressure, and Redis as the broker.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.title: Microservice architecture articles
architecture.description: Architecture articles on service-oriented Node.js back-ends: splitting a monolith, service boundaries, discovery, load balancing and inter-service calls.

comparison.label: Comparisons
comparison.title: Framework and queue comparisons
comparison.description: Even-handed comparisons of @imqueue with BullMQ, Moleculer, NestJS microservices, tRPC and gRPC — what each one is for, and when to pick the other one.

rpc.label: RPC
rpc.title: RPC between Node.js services
rpc.description: Articles on RPC between Node.js microservices: request/reply over a message queue, typed clients, RPC over Redis, and why internal APIs need not be REST.

dx.label: Developer experience
dx.title: Developer experience articles
dx.description: Articles on developer experience in Node.js microservices: cutting boilerplate, generated typed clients, running a local fleet, and isolated CLI environments.

patterns.label: Patterns
patterns.title: Messaging patterns for Node.js
patterns.description: Messaging patterns for Node.js services: request/reply, competing consumers, work queues, delayed and recurring work, and Redis pub/sub versus streams.

types.label: Type safety
types.title: Type safety across services
types.description: Articles on end-to-end type safety between TypeScript microservices: generated clients, sharing types without a shared package, and versioning safely.

resilience.label: Resilience
resilience.title: Resilience and safe deploys
resilience.description: Articles on keeping Node.js services healthy under load and during deploys: back-pressure, graceful shutdown, zero-drop deploys and delivery guarantees.

jobs.label: Jobs & scheduling
jobs.title: Background jobs and scheduled work
jobs.description: Articles on background jobs and background tasks in Node.js and nodejs services: delayed calls, scheduled work, retry backoff, recurring sweeps, and how @imqueue/job compares with BullMQ.

clients.label: Typed clients
clients.title: Generated typed service clients

transport.label: Transports
transport.title: Transports under your services

tooling.label: Tooling

discovery.label: Service discovery

delivery.label: Message delivery
delivery.title: Message delivery guarantees

frameworks.label: Frameworks
